name: Should I reface or replace my kitchen cabinets?
description: Choose refacing if current cabinet boxes are sound and you like the layout; replace if you want to change the layout, add storage, or if boxes are damaged.

mainEntity.name: Should I reface or replace my kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to reface or replace your kitchen cabinets depends on their current condition, your budget, and desired outcome. Refacing is a good option if your existing cabinet boxes are structurally sound and you're happy with the current layout, offering a significant aesthetic update at a lower cost and quicker timeline. Cabinet replacement is ideal if you want to change the kitchen layout, add more functional storage, or if your current cabinet boxes are damaged. Consider your long-term goals for the kitchen and assess the structural integrity of your current cabinets before making a decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose refacing if current cabinet boxes are sound and you like the layout; replace if you want to change the layout, add storage, or if boxes are damaged.
